kebab_example: aliyun hitsdb release-lindorm-v2-instance --instance-id ld-bp1o3y0yme2i20000 --immediately true --api-version 2020-06-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReleaseLindormV2Instance

parameters.description_en: The ID of the instance. Call the [GetLindormInstanceList](~~190281~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190281.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to immediately release the instance. Default value: false. If this parameter is set to false, the instance data is retained for 7 days before it is deleted. If this parameter is set to true, the instance data is deleted immediately.
parameters.description_zh: 是否立即释放实例。默认false，实例数据会继续保留7天，然后删除；如果选择true，实例数据会被立刻删除。
